title: Find Usages
summary: Lists every reference to the symbol under the editor caret across the indexed project
intro: Read this before changing or removing a symbol, to see every place it is used. With the caret on the symbol choose drag-lint > Find Usages... (Ctrl+Alt+F); the same list comes from the command line as `drag-lint usages --name <X> --db <db>`.

steps: Needs an index of the project
Put the editor caret on the symbol

questions.ask: Where is the symbol under my caret used?
